description.zh_cn: 点击一个可见目标；必须按 schema 提供 target_description、x、y。
description.en_us: Tap a visible target; provide target_description, x, and y as required by the schema.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - click(target_description, x, y): 点击可见目标；x/y 是 required 的 0..1000 相对坐标。
prompt_guide.en_us: - click(target_description, x, y): Tap a visible target; x/y are required 0..1000 relative coordinates.

description.zh_cn: 要点击的目标描述。
description.en_us: Description of the target to tap.

description.zh_cn: 可选。live XML 中已确认的无障碍节点 id。
description.en_us: Optional. Confirmed accessibility node id from live XML.

description.zh_cn: 可选。录制或 XML grounding 得到的 Android resource-id，用于重放定位诊断和迁移。
description.en_us: Optional. Android resource-id captured from recording or XML grounding, used for replay targeting diagnostics and transfer.

description.zh_cn: 点击位置的 required 0..1000 相对 X 坐标；执行前会解码为屏幕绝对像素。
description.en_us: Required 0..1000 relative X coordinate of the tap target; decoded to absolute screen pixels before execution.

description.zh_cn: 点击位置的 required 0..1000 相对 Y 坐标；执行前会解码为屏幕绝对像素。
description.en_us: Required 0..1000 relative Y coordinate of the tap target; decoded to absolute screen pixels before execution.

description.zh_cn: 长按一个目标。
description.en_us: Long-press a target.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - long_press(target_description, x, y): 长按目标；x/y 是 required 的 0..1000 相对坐标。
prompt_guide.en_us: - long_press(target_description, x, y): Long-press a target; x/y are required 0..1000 relative coordinates.

description.zh_cn: 要长按的目标描述。
description.en_us: Description of the target to long-press.

description.zh_cn: 可选。live XML 中已确认的无障碍节点 id。
description.en_us: Optional. Confirmed accessibility node id from live XML.

description.zh_cn: 可选。录制或 XML grounding 得到的 Android resource-id，用于重放定位诊断和迁移。
description.en_us: Optional. Android resource-id captured from recording or XML grounding, used for replay targeting diagnostics and transfer.

description.zh_cn: 长按位置的 0..1000 相对 X 坐标；执行前会解码为屏幕绝对像素。
description.en_us: 0..1000 relative X coordinate of the long press; decoded to absolute screen pixels before execution.

description.zh_cn: 长按位置的 0..1000 相对 Y 坐标；执行前会解码为屏幕绝对像素。
description.en_us: 0..1000 relative Y coordinate of the long press; decoded to absolute screen pixels before execution.

description.zh_cn: 长按时长，单位毫秒。
description.en_us: Long-press duration in milliseconds.

description.zh_cn: 向一个可见输入目标输入文本；必须按 schema 提供 target_description、text、x、y。
description.en_us: Type text into a visible input target; provide target_description, text, x, and y as required by the schema.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - input_text(target_description, text, x, y): 向输入框输入；x/y 是 required 的 0..1000 相对坐标。
prompt_guide.en_us: - input_text(target_description, text, x, y): Type into an input field; x/y are required 0..1000 relative coordinates.

description.zh_cn: 要输入文本的目标输入框描述。
description.en_us: Description of the input target.

description.zh_cn: 要输入的文本内容。
description.en_us: Text content to type.

description.zh_cn: 可选。live XML 中已确认的无障碍节点 id。
description.en_us: Optional. Confirmed accessibility node id from live XML.

description.zh_cn: 可选。录制或 XML grounding 得到的 Android resource-id，用于重放定位诊断和迁移。
description.en_us: Optional. Android resource-id captured from recording or XML grounding, used for replay targeting diagnostics and transfer.

description.zh_cn: 目标输入框中心的 required 0..1000 相对 X 坐标；执行前会解码为屏幕绝对像素。
description.en_us: Required 0..1000 relative X coordinate of the input target center; decoded to absolute screen pixels before execution.

description.zh_cn: 目标输入框中心的 required 0..1000 相对 Y 坐标；执行前会解码为屏幕绝对像素。
description.en_us: Required 0..1000 relative Y coordinate of the input target center; decoded to absolute screen pixels before execution.

description.zh_cn: 在屏幕或可滚动区域内按方向滑动。
description.en_us: Swipe in a direction on the screen or inside a scrollable region.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - swipe(target_description, direction, x1, y1, x2, y2, duration_ms?): 在屏幕或指定可滚动区域内滑动；direction 和 x1/y1/x2/y2 必须满足 schema.required。
prompt_guide.en_us: - swipe(target_description, direction, x1, y1, x2, y2, duration_ms?): Swipe on the screen or a target scrollable region; direction and x1/y1/x2/y2 must satisfy schema.required.

description.zh_cn: 本次滑动想浏览或定位的目标描述。
description.en_us: Description of what this swipe action is trying to browse or locate.

description.zh_cn: 滑动方向。
description.en_us: Swipe direction.

description.zh_cn: 可选。滑动锚点的 0..1000 相对 X 坐标；不提供时使用安全兜底区域。
description.en_us: Optional 0..1000 relative swipe anchor X coordinate; when omitted, the runtime uses a safe fallback region.

description.zh_cn: 可选。滑动锚点的 0..1000 相对 Y 坐标；不提供时使用安全兜底区域。
description.en_us: Optional 0..1000 relative swipe anchor Y coordinate; when omitted, the runtime uses a safe fallback region.

description.zh_cn: 可选。滑动距离，使用 0..1000 相对坐标尺度。
description.en_us: Optional swipe distance using the 0..1000 relative coordinate scale.

description.zh_cn: 滑动起点的 0..1000 相对 X 坐标；执行前会解码为屏幕绝对像素。
description.en_us: Start 0..1000 relative X coordinate; decoded to absolute screen pixels before execution.

description.zh_cn: 滑动起点的 0..1000 相对 Y 坐标；执行前会解码为屏幕绝对像素。
description.en_us: Start 0..1000 relative Y coordinate; decoded to absolute screen pixels before execution.

description.zh_cn: 滑动终点的 0..1000 相对 X 坐标；执行前会解码为屏幕绝对像素。
description.en_us: End 0..1000 relative X coordinate; decoded to absolute screen pixels before execution.

description.zh_cn: 滑动终点的 0..1000 相对 Y 坐标；执行前会解码为屏幕绝对像素。
description.en_us: End 0..1000 relative Y coordinate; decoded to absolute screen pixels before execution.

description.zh_cn: 滑动时长，单位毫秒。
description.en_us: Swipe duration in milliseconds.

description.zh_cn: 打开指定应用。
description.en_us: Open a specific app.

description.zh_cn: 目标应用的 Android package name。
description.en_us: Android package name of the target app.

description.zh_cn: 按一个系统导航键。
description.en_us: Press one system navigation key.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - press_key(key): 按系统导航键；key 只能是 back、home 或 enter。
prompt_guide.en_us: - press_key(key): Press a system navigation key; key must be back, home, or enter.

description.zh_cn: 系统键名称。
description.en_us: System key name.

description.zh_cn: 等待页面加载、动画或外部状态变化。
description.en_us: Wait for page loading, animation, or external state changes.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - wait(duration_ms): 只在页面明确处于加载、动画或等待外部状态变化时使用。
prompt_guide.en_us: - wait(duration_ms): Use only when the page is clearly loading, animating, or waiting for an external state change.

description.zh_cn: 等待时长，单位毫秒。
description.en_us: Wait duration in milliseconds.

description.zh_cn: 不执行 UI 操作，只重新获取当前页面状态、包名和 Accessibility tree。
description.en_us: Do not perform a UI action; refresh the current page state, package name, and Accessibility tree.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - 内部状态刷新：运行时每轮自动读取当前页面状态；该动作不暴露给模型或前端，不点击、不滑动、不输入。
prompt_guide.en_us: - Internal state refresh: the runtime reads the current page state automatically each turn; this action is not exposed to the model or frontend and does not tap, swipe, or type.

description.zh_cn: 为什么需要重新获取状态，例如上一步操作失败、页面无变化或当前页面不确定。
description.en_us: Why state refresh is needed, such as previous action failed, page did not change, or current page is uncertain.

description.zh_cn: 内部工具调用动作。Function recall/replay 由运行时自动决定，普通 VLM/Agent 不直接选择该动作。
description.en_us: Internal tool-call action. Function recall/replay is selected by the runtime; normal VLM/Agent output does not choose this action directly.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - 内部动作：不要在普通 VLM/Agent 输出中生成 call_tool；Function 命中由运行时自动执行。
prompt_guide.en_us: - Internal action: do not emit call_tool in normal VLM/Agent output; Function hits are executed by the runtime.

description.zh_cn: 内部 RunLog/replay 中保存的 Function id；普通 VLM/Agent 输出不填写。
description.en_us: Function id stored in internal RunLog/replay actions; normal VLM/Agent output does not fill this.

description.zh_cn: 内部 RunLog/replay 中保存的工具名；普通 VLM/Agent 输出不填写。
description.en_us: Tool name stored in internal RunLog/replay actions; normal VLM/Agent output does not fill this.

description.zh_cn: 工具或 Function 的业务参数；无参使用空对象。
description.en_us: Business arguments for the tool or Function; use an empty object for no arguments.

description.zh_cn: 仅当当前页面或上一轮工具结果直接证明用户目标已经完成时结束。
description.en_us: End only when the current page or previous tool result directly proves the user's goal is complete.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - finished(content?): 仅在当前页面或上一轮工具结果直接证明目标完成时调用；不确定就继续执行下一步。
prompt_guide.en_us: - finished(content?): Call only when the current page or previous tool result directly proves completion; if uncertain, continue with the next action.

description.zh_cn: 给用户的最终完成说明，可为空。
description.en_us: Final completion note for the user. May be empty.

description.zh_cn: 向用户询问或请求手动协助。
description.en_us: Ask the user a question or request manual help.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - info(value): 询问用户或请求用户协助。
prompt_guide.en_us: - info(value): Ask the user for information or manual assistance.

description.zh_cn: 你要问用户的问题或需要用户执行的说明。
description.en_us: Question to ask the user or instructions for the user to perform.

description.zh_cn: 反馈当前上下文与目标不匹配。
description.en_us: Report that the current context does not match the goal.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - feedback(value): 请求上层重新规划。
prompt_guide.en_us: - feedback(value): Ask the upper layer to re-plan.

description.zh_cn: 反馈原因。
description.en_us: Reason for the feedback.

description.zh_cn: 任务无法继续时终止。
description.en_us: Abort when the task cannot continue.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - abort(value?): 在任务无法继续时终止。
prompt_guide.en_us: - abort(value?): Abort when the task cannot continue.

description.zh_cn: 终止任务的原因。
description.en_us: Reason for aborting the task.

description.zh_cn: 让用户在若干选项中选择一个。
description.en_us: Ask the user to choose one option from a list.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - require_user_choice(options, prompt): 让用户做互斥选择。
prompt_guide.en_us: - require_user_choice(options, prompt): Ask the user to make a mutually exclusive choice.

description.zh_cn: 可供用户选择的选项列表。
description.en_us: List of options the user can choose from.

description.zh_cn: 要求用户做选择的提示文案。
description.en_us: Prompt shown to the user when asking for a choice.

description.zh_cn: 让用户确认当前状态后继续。
description.en_us: Ask the user to confirm the current state before continuing.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - require_user_confirmation(prompt): 让用户确认后继续。
prompt_guide.en_us: - require_user_confirmation(prompt): Ask the user to confirm before continuing.

description.zh_cn: 要求用户确认的提示文案。
description.en_us: Prompt asking the user for confirmation.
